comapny: a2c , generative ai engineer , philadelphia , About the job Job Title: Generative AI Engineer Summary: We’re seeking a Generative AI Engineer to design and build innovative AI-driven solutions. This role focuses on developing and optimizing generative models using deep learning techniques to deliver impactful, production-ready applications. You’ll partner with cross-functional teams to bring AI concepts to life and drive real business value in a fast-evolving space. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and implement generative AI models using modern deep learning frameworks; Collaborate with engineering, product, and business teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems; Research and apply the latest advancements in generative AI, LLMs, and related technologies; Optimize model performance, scalability, and efficiency for production environments; Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the AI development lifecycle; Document models, workflows, and technical processes clearly and effectively; Translate complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders; Support additional initiatives as needed.

company: hmp global , ai workflow engineer , Location: Remote or Hybrid. Hybrid – if within 50 miles of the Malvern, PA, or East Windsor, NJ office. In-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Work from home on Mondays and Fridays. Travel: this is not a road warrior role; travel is expected when necessary and is expected once per month. Competitive: guaranteed annual base salary + year-end bonus opportunity. Comprehensive Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k w/company match). HMP Global is a leading healthcare media and information company that produces world-class events, digital media brands, and educational content for healthcare professionals. We have completed a company-wide assessment of AI automation opportunities and identified a deep pipeline of high-priority workflows across several departments where AI-driven tools can recapture significant FTE hours and improve the consistency and quality of the products and services that HMP Global delivers to its customers. Scaling from early prototypes to a complete portfolio of production-grade AI workflows requires dedicated technical expertise. This role exists to provide that capability: an embedded AI engineer who translates operational needs into deployed, governed, and continuously improved AI tools — and who rigorously measures their impact. This is not a research or advisory role. The AI Workflow Engineer will build, ship, and maintain tools in direct partnership with domain experts across the organization. What You’ll Do: Build AI Tools That Solve Real Operational Problems; Create the Playbook So AI Development Scales Beyond You; Own Governance, Measurement, and ROI. Key Qualifications: Required: 3+ years building production AI/ML applications, hands-on proficiency with OpenAI APIs and Anthropic Claude, strong software engineering fundamentals, experience integrating AI tools with enterprise systems, excellent communication skills. Preferred: Experience in healthcare, pharma services, medical education, or B2B media; background in prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic AI frameworks. What Success Looks Like: First 30 Days - Complete onboarding sprints; First 90 Days - Deliver multiple production-ready AI tools; First 6 Months - Majority of the pipeline deployed or in active development.
